tagline.en: The Gerald R. Ford Freeway, and a number that moved
tagline.zh: 杰拉尔德·福特高速：一个搬过家的编号

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.en: I-94 at Benton Harbor, on Lake Michigan
start.zh: 密歇根湖畔本顿港，与 I-94 相接

end.zh: 大急流城，与 I-96 相接

en: I-196 runs up the east shore of Lake Michigan from I-94 at Benton Harbor through South Haven and Holland, then turns inland and east through Grandville into Grand Rapids, where it ends on I-96. The odd hundreds digit is the giveaway: this is a spur, not a loop. It meets its parent I-96 at one end only, and the other end is on a different Interstate altogether, which is how it manages to be 80.47 miles long while still counting as an auxiliary route.

Most of it is a two-lane-each-way rural freeway through orchards and dune country; the busy part is the last few miles, the Gerald R. Ford Freeway through Grand Rapids, where the 2016 state counts peaked at 89,600 vehicles a day just east of downtown. At the other extreme the quietest stretch carried 20,915. It is the main road from Chicago to the Michigan lakeshore resorts, so summer weekends load it in a way the annual averages hide.
zh: I-196 自本顿港的 I-94 起，沿密歇根湖东岸北上，经南黑文与荷兰市，随后转向内陆，向东穿过格兰德维尔进入大急流城，在那里与 I-96 相接而终止。奇数百位是线索：这是一条支线，不是环线。它只有一端接上母线 I-96，另一端接的是另一条州际公路——正因如此，它长 80.47 英里，却仍算辅助路线。
大部分路段是穿过果园与沙丘地带的双向四车道乡村高速；繁忙的是最后几英里，即穿过大急流城的杰拉尔德·福特高速：2016 年州级交通量统计在市中心以东达到每日 89,600 辆的峰值。另一个极端是最清闲的一段，为 20,915 辆。它是从芝加哥前往密歇根湖岸度假地的主路，夏季周末的负荷会被年均值掩盖。

en: The number belonged to a different road first. In the 1950s the federal approvals put I-96 on the Benton Harbor–Grand Rapids–Detroit line and gave I-196 to the spur from Grand Rapids north-west to Muskegon; the first I-196 markers went up in 1959 and that road was finished in December 1962. Before the south-western leg was done, the Michigan State Highway Department asked to swap the two numbers west of Grand Rapids. Permission came in 1963 and the signs were changed in January 1964 — so the old I-196 became part of I-96, and the Lake Michigan freeway became I-196.

The Grand Rapids section came next: 12.5 miles from Chicago Drive in Grandville through downtown to I-96, opened on 14 December 1964, at a cost of $40 million. The final 24.5-mile gap, from south-west of Holland to Grandville, opened on 8 December 1974 after an eleven-year effort, dedicated at a ceremony at the 44th Street interchange attended by three of President Ford's brothers. That completed I-196 for the second time — the number had already been completed once, on a different alignment.
zh: 这个编号最初属于另一条路。1950 年代，联邦批复把 I-96 定在本顿港－大急流城－底特律一线，把 I-196 给了从大急流城向西北通往马斯基根的支线；首批 I-196 标志于 1959 年立起，该路于 1962 年 12 月建成。在西南段完工之前，密歇根州公路局申请把大急流城以西两个编号互换。许可于 1963 年下达，标志在 1964 年 1 月更换——于是老的 I-196 成了 I-96 的一部分，密歇根湖岸那条高速成了 I-196。
接下来是大急流城段：自格兰德维尔的芝加哥大道穿过市中心至 I-96，共 12.5 英里，1964 年 12 月 14 日通车，造价 4,000 万美元。最后 24.5 英里的缺口，自荷兰市西南至格兰德维尔，在历时十一年的建设后于 1974 年 12 月 8 日通车；通车仪式在 44 街立交举行，福特总统的三位兄弟到场。这标志着 I-196 第二次建成——这个编号此前已在另一条线位上完整过一次。

why.en: The freeway was built over seventeen years in separate contracts under two different route numbers, and Michigan's records give segment costs rather than a total for I-196 as it now exists.
why.zh: 这条高速在十七年间以两个不同编号、分若干合同建成，密歇根州的档案给出的是分段造价，而非现今 I-196 全线的总额。

timeline.en: The first I-196 markers go up — on the Grand Rapids–Muskegon freeway, now I-96.
timeline.zh: 首批 I-196 标志立起，位于今为 I-96 的大急流城－马斯基根高速上。

timeline.en: The numbers are swapped west of Grand Rapids and the Grand Rapids section opens in December.
timeline.zh: 大急流城以西两个编号互换，大急流城段于 12 月通车。

timeline.en: The last 24.5 miles between Holland and Grandville open on 8 December.
timeline.zh: 荷兰市与格兰德维尔之间最后 24.5 英里于 12 月 8 日通车。
